sentences: Anywhere but Here is a 1999 American coming-of-age comedy-drama film, based on the novel of the same name by Mona Simpson.
The screenplay was written by Alvin Sargent, and the film was directed by Wayne Wang.
It was produced by Laurence Mark, Petra Alexandria, and Ginny Nugent.
It stars Susan Sarandon, Natalie Portman, and Shawn Hatosy.
The film debuted at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 17, 1999, before being released in the United States on November 12.
